title: hylotelephium pluricaule
intro: Hylotelephium pluricaule, commonly known as Korean stonecrop or ghost stonecrop, is a plant species in the family Crassulaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its ability to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hylotelephium pluricaule include its ability to promote wound healing, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
